CommunityApplications.Profile: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Unraid 打包与容器模板：多架构镜像（amd64/arm64）、跟随上游 npm 发版自动重建、并为没有 Landlock 的 Unraid 内核内置 bubblewrap 沙箱与相应的启动参数。仓库里同时有中英文安装文档、沙箱原理与迁移指南。| Unraid packaging and the container template for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): a multi-arch image rebuilt automatically from the newest upstream release, shipping a bubblewrap sandbox for kernels without Landlock, with documentation in Chinese and English.
